school: 无产阶级革命思想/毛泽东思想/政治权谋理论
intellectual_tradition: 马克思列宁主义/毛泽东思想/秘密战理论/政治整肃方法论
representative_works: 延安整风运动理论指导
historical_significance: 康生（1898-1975），原名张宗可，山东诸城人。中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、书法家，原正国级领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、中共中央副主席、全国人大常委会副委员长、全国政协副主席等职务。他是延安整风运动、文化大革命的主要推动者之一，在党内秘密战线、理论整肃、政治斗争等方面有重要影响。康生在政治上善于见风使舵，在理论上深谙政治权谋，在艺术上造诣深厚，是中共历史上最具复杂性和争议性的领导人之一。他的工作方法和思想特点体现了政治斗争的残酷性、理论整肃的系统性、秘密工作的隐蔽性和政治投机的机会主义特征。
core_thoughts: 秘密战工作法——建立秘密机构网络，进行情报侦察和政治保卫
整肃肃反法——通过政治运动清除异己，巩固权力基础
政治权谋法——善于观察形势变化，适时调整政治立场和策略
理论整肃法——利用意识形态斗争打击政治对手，推动个人崇拜
机会主义法——在政治斗争中寻求最大个人利益，善于趋炎附势
famous_quote: 整风必然转入审干，审干必然转入肃反
influence: 康生对中共党史产生了深远影响，特别是在延安整风运动和文化大革命中，他的政治整肃理论和方法塑造了中共内部的政治文化。他的秘密战线工作为中共的安全保卫工作奠定了基础，但也造成了大量冤假错案。在书法艺术方面，他是中共领导层中造诣最高的书法家之一，对传统书法艺术有重要贡献。然而，由于其政治上的负面形象，其艺术成就长期被忽视。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 建立秘密机构网络，发展情报力量，进行隐蔽斗争，保卫党的安全和领导核心。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish secret institutional networks, develop intelligence capabilities, conduct covert operations, and protect Party security and leadership core.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 延安时期中央社会部工作实践
process_zh: 机构设置：建立秘密工作体系
人员发展：发展秘密情报力量
线索收集：掌握敌情和内部动态
隐蔽行动：进行秘密侦察和打击
巩固成果：确保安全局面
process_en: Institution establishment: Build secret work system
Personnel development: Develop intelligence forces
Information collection: Master enemy and internal dynamics
Covert operations: Conduct secret reconnaissance and strikes
Result consolidation: Ensure security situation
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 秘密战线是党的生命线
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The secret front is the lifeline of the Party
representative_cases_zh: 建立延安时期中央社会部
representative_cases_en: Established Central Social Department in Yan'an

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过政治运动形式，以整风-审干-肃反三段论方式清除党内异己分子，巩固权力基础。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Through political movement form, using rectification-examination-purge three-stage process to eliminate Party dissidents and consolidate power foundation.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 延安整风运动与抢救失足者运动
process_zh: 运动发动：以整风名义发起政治运动
扩大范围：从整风扩展到审干
升级打击：从审干升级到肃反
制造证据：构陷罪名，制造冤案
巩固成果：清除异己，巩固权力
process_en: Movement launch: Initiate political movement under rectification name
Expand scope: From rectification to examination
Escalate strikes: From examination to purge
Fabricate evidence: Frame charges and create false cases
Consolidate results: Eliminate dissidents, consolidate power
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 整风必然转入审干，审干必然转入肃反
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Rectification inevitably turns into examination, and examination inevitably turns into purge.
representative_cases_en: Yan'an Rescue Movement for those who lost their way

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 善于观察政治形势变化，适时调整政治立场，运用权谋手段在政治斗争中获取最大利益。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Good at observing political situation changes, timely adjusting political stance, using strategic means to maximize benefits in political struggles.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 康生党内政治生涯分析
process_zh: 形势研判：准确把握政治形势发展趋势
立场调整：根据形势变化适时转换立场
权谋运作：运用政治手腕打击对手
利益获取：在斗争中实现个人利益最大化
风险规避：避免在政治斗争中受损
process_en: Situation analysis: Accurately grasp political trend
Stance adjustment: Convert stance timely according to changes
Strategic operation: Use political means to strike opponents
Benefit acquisition: Maximize personal benefits in struggle
Risk avoidance: Avoid damage in political struggle
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 政治斗争中没有永恒的朋友，只有永恒的利益
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: In political struggle there are no eternal friends, only eternal interests.
representative_cases_zh: 追随王明后转向支持毛泽东
在庐山会议批判彭德怀
在文革中与林彪江青集团合作
利用诗词和书法与毛泽东建立特殊关系
representative_cases_en: After following Wang Ming, turned to support Mao Zedong
Criticized Peng Dehuai at Lushan Conference
Cooperated with Lin Biao and Jiang Qing groups during Cultural Revolution
Used poetry and calligraphy to establish special relationship with Mao Zedong

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 利用意识形态斗争理论，通过批判理论观点打击政治对手，推动个人崇拜和思想统一。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Utilize ideological struggle theory, through criticism of theoretical views to defeat political opponents, promote personality cult and thought unity.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 延安整风运动中的理论斗争
process_zh: 理论建构：确立官方理论标准
批判斗争：批判不符合的理论观点
思想改造：强制接受官方意识形态
个人崇拜：塑造领袖绝对权威
思想统一：实现全党思想高度一致
process_en: Theory construction: Establish official theoretical standards
Critical struggle: Criticize non-conforming theoretical views
Ideological reform: Force acceptance of official ideology
Personality cult: Shape absolute leadership authority
Thought unity: Achieve extreme ideological consistency across the Party
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 思想战线上的斗争是最根本的斗争
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Ideological struggle is the most fundamental struggle.
representative_cases_en: Promoted Criticize Lin Biao and Confucius Movement

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 在政治斗争中寻求最大个人利益，善于观察政治风向，及时转换立场，趋炎附势获取政治利益。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Seek maximum personal benefits in political struggles, good at observing political winds, timely converting stance, and gaining political benefits through sycophancy.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 康生党内政治投机行为分析
process_zh: 利益评估：评估各种政治选择对个人利益的影响
风向观察：密切关注政治形势变化
立场调整：根据利益需要灵活转换立场
关系运作：与当权者建立特殊关系
风险控制：在政治斗争中保护自己
process_en: Benefit assessment: Evaluate impact of political choices on personal interests
Wind observation: Closely monitor political situation changes
Stance adjustment: Flexibly convert stance according to benefit needs
Relationship operation: Establish special relationships with those in power
Risk control: Protect oneself in political struggle
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 在政治斗争中，立场必须服从利益
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: In political struggle, stance must submit to interests.
representative_cases_zh: 从追随王明转向支持毛泽东
在文革中与林彪江青集团合作
利用诗词书法与毛泽东建立特殊关系
在政治运动中保护自身安全
representative_cases_en: After following Wang Ming, turned to support Mao Zedong
Cooperated with Lin Biao and Jiang Qing groups during Cultural Revolution
Used poetry and calligraphy to establish special relationship with Mao Zedong
Protected oneself safety in political movements

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 善于组织和发动政治运动，通过群众运动形式实现政治目的，掌握群众运动规律。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Good at organizing and launching political movements, achieving political goals through mass movement forms, mastering mass movement laws.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 文化大革命群众运动实践
process_zh: 理论准备：为运动提供理论依据
舆论宣传：制造有利于运动的舆论氛围
组织发动：建立运动组织体系
群众动员：调动群众参与积极性
运动控制：把握运动方向和节奏
process_en: Theoretical preparation: Provide theoretical basis for movement
Publicity and propaganda: Create favorable public opinion atmosphere
Organization launch: Establish movement organizational system
Mass mobilization: Mobilize mass participation enthusiasm
Movement control: Grasp movement direction and rhythm
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 群众运动是政治斗争最有力的武器
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Mass movement is the most powerful weapon in political struggle.
representative_cases_zh: 推动文化大革命群众运动

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过政治手段整合各方力量，建立统一的政治领导体系，实现对权力的集中控制。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Integrate various forces through political means, establish unified political leadership system, achieve centralized control of power.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 中央组织宣传组工作实践
process_zh: 权力分析：分析各方力量对比和利益关系
策略制定：制定权力整合策略
力量协调：协调各方利益和力量
制度建设：建立统一的政治制度
集中领导：实现权力的集中统一领导
process_en: Power analysis: Analyze power comparison and interest relationships
Strategy formulation: Formulate power integration strategy
Force coordination: Coordinate interests and forces of all sides
System construction: Establish unified political system
Centralized leadership: Achieve centralized unified power leadership
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 权力必须集中，统一才能胜利
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Power must be centralized; unity brings victory.
representative_cases_en: Established Central Organization and Propaganda Group

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 运用特务政治手段，通过秘密监视、侦察、打击等方式维护政治安全和权力稳定。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Use secret police political means, maintain political security and power stability through secret surveillance, reconnaissance, and strikes.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 中央社会部特务工作实践
process_zh: 情报收集：收集敌情和内部情报
秘密监视：对可疑对象进行秘密监视
侦察打击：对威胁进行秘密打击
安全防护：保护核心安全
权力维护：维护权力稳定
process_en: Intelligence collection: Gather enemy and internal intelligence
Secret surveillance: Conduct covert monitoring of suspicious targets
Reconnaissance strikes: Secretly strike threats
Security protection: Protect core security
Power maintenance: Maintain power stability
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 没有秘密工作就没有革命的胜利
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Without secret work there is no revolutionary victory.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 在政治斗争中进行投机，通过把握政治风向、寻找政治机会来实现个人政治地位的提升。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Engage in speculation in political struggles, achieve promotion of personal political status by grasping political winds and finding political opportunities.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 康生政治投机行为综合分析
process_zh: 政治观察：观察政治形势变化
机会识别：识别政治发展机会
策略制定：制定投机策略
行动实施：采取投机行动
风险控制：控制投机风险
process_en: Political observation: Observe political situation changes
Opportunity identification: Identify political development opportunities
Strategy formulation: Formulate speculation strategy
Action implementation: Take speculative actions
Risk control: Control speculation risks
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 政治投机者善于在危机中寻找机遇
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Political speculators are good at finding opportunities in crises.
representative_cases_zh: 在关键时刻转变政治立场
利用政治运动提升地位
与当权者建立特殊关系
在政治危机中保护自己
representative_cases_en: Changed political stance at critical moments
Used political movements to elevate status
Established special relationships with those in power

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 精通书法艺术和诗词创作，通过文化艺术手段建立与政治领导层的特殊关系，提升个人文化影响力。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Master calligraphy art and poetry creation, build special relationships with political leadership through cultural and artistic means, enhance personal cultural influence.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 康生书法艺术与诗词创作研究
process_zh: 艺术学习：学习传统书法和诗词
创作实践：进行书法和诗词创作
关系建立：通过艺术与领导层建立关系
影响力提升：通过艺术提升个人影响力
政治利用：将艺术作为政治工具
process_en: Art learning: Study traditional calligraphy and poetry
Creative practice: Conduct calligraphy and poetry creation
Relationship building: Establish relationships with leadership through art
Influence enhancement: Enhance personal influence through art
Political utilization: Use art as political tool
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 文化艺术是政治斗争的特殊武器
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Culture and art are special weapons in political struggle.

利用文化特长影响政治决策
representative_cases_en: Participated in 'Selected Works of Mao Zedition' publication
Used cultural specialties to influence political decisions
